title: Statistics for ML: Estimation and Testing
description: Decide whether a result is real or noise, the way a rigorous ML practitioner does.
learningOutcomes: Explain sampling and estimation with real intuition
Run and interpret a hypothesis test correctly
Explain confidence intervals without the common misinterpretation

lessons.title: Samples, Populations, and Estimation
lessons.description: Why a sample statistic is a guess, not the truth.
learningObjectives: Distinguish a population from a sample
Compute a sample mean and standard deviation

lessons.title: Confidence Intervals
lessons.description: A range that communicates uncertainty honestly.
learningObjectives: Compute a confidence interval for a mean
Explain what a confidence interval does NOT mean
Connect interval width to sample size

lessons.title: Hypothesis Testing
lessons.description: Deciding whether a difference is real, with a p-value done correctly.
learningObjectives: State a null and alternative hypothesis
Interpret a p-value without the common misreading
Explain Type I and Type II errors

lessons.title: A/B Testing in Practice
lessons.description: Apply hypothesis testing to a realistic product experiment.
learningObjectives: Test whether a metric difference is statistically significant
Explain why statistical significance isn't the whole story
